Pre-PS: Of course, Lean will also be represented appropriately (we are still waiting for confirmations of invited speakers) :)

Dear all,

we are pleased to announce the summer school

Interactions of Proof Assistants and Mathematics,
September 18-29, 2023, University of Regensburg.
https://itp-school-2023.github.io/

The school will present state-of-the-art proof assistants from
different angles: including theoretical foundations, engineering
aspects, and applications in areas in mathematics and computer
science. The goal of the summer school is to introduce proof
assistants to students and researchers in both mathematics and
computer science, while fostering collaboration and exchange between
these communities. The programme will consist of short courses,
research talks, tutorials, exercise sessions, and contributed talks.

The list of speakers includes:

  • Benedikt Ahrens
  • Steve Awodey
  • Andrej Bauer
  • Yves Bertot
  • Thierry Coquand
  • John Harrison
  • Angeliki Koutsoukou-Argyraki
  • Conor McBride
  • Paige Randall North
  • Emily Riehl
  • Michael Shulman

Registration for participation and contributed talks will open in May
and close on June 9. Updates and further information will be posted on
the summer school homepage

https://itp-school-2023.github.io/ .

The summer school will take place in September 2023 in the town centre
of Regensburg in Bavaria, Germany. The Old Town of Regensburg is
listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and considered the largest
authentically preserved medieval city in Germany.

Best regards,
Denis-Charles Cisinski, Clara Löh, Philipp Rümmer
